items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: We didn't have no big bands if we wanted, Johnny. ... we had a gang of us. ... brass band of Louis, myself, King Oliver, and Lee Collins

ctx.x: A street band. And we had the band to do it. George Field, the Dutre. And that fellow, what's his name to get a trombone player? Oh, I know him. Kid O'Ree. And they had, oh, we had about two of us. Oh, I know him. Oh, well, he died. Well, they didn't let us put up that brass band of Louis, myself, King Oliver, and Lee Collins, and Oliver. We had a gang of us. We'd come down that street, we'd kill them. And we just needed 12 men. You know, we didn't have no big bands if we wanted, Johnny.

Mr. Dominant, really, it seems like you're about to last at the Ohegan's, aren't you? Huh? You're about to last at the Ohegan's, aren't you? Yeah. Me and Louie and I? Yeah. I found on TV the other night. Yeah. He's failing, kid. Yeah, he is.

You know, he called up to it. One time, when he came in, he was at the airport, he called up, he called me. He said, Greg, what'd you know? I said, who's this? He said, it's Louie. We know, Cush. I said, you know what I know? You better give up that horn. I ain't give up that horn, I'm tired of it, man. That's his words, you know. I said, go and die, kill yourself.
